title: Chainsaw Man
description: A collection reflecting the gritty tone of _Chainsaw Man_, which combines horror, dark comedy, and action. It draws on devil-themed imagery, urban Japanese environments, and a raw, high-contrast visual style that sets the series apart from more conventional shonen anime.

chainsaw-man-000001.title: Aki Hayakawa — Fox Devil
chainsaw-man-000001.description: Aki Hayakawa summons the Fox Devil using its hand sign.

chainsaw-man-000002.title: Angel
chainsaw-man-000002.description: Angel Devil with a sad, contemplative expression.

chainsaw-man-000003.title: Denji — Artwork
chainsaw-man-000003.description: Minimalist artwork of Denji in his Chainsaw Devil form, with the devil's cord depicted inside his chest.

chainsaw-man-000004.title: Himeno in the Graveyard
chainsaw-man-000004.description: An injured Himeno surrounded by crows, looking toward a friend's grave.

chainsaw-man-000005.title: Makima — Control Devil
chainsaw-man-000005.description: Fan art of Makima in her Control Devil form, with demonic wings and an angelic halo, wearing a Devil Hunter uniform.

chainsaw-man-000006.title: Makima
chainsaw-man-000006.description: A close-up of Makima's eyes rendered in a vibrant purple and blue color palette.

chainsaw-man-000007.title: Makima — Death Stare
chainsaw-man-000007.description: Makima with a serious expression against a white background.

chainsaw-man-000008.title: Power — Blood Manipulation
chainsaw-man-000008.description: Power using her Blood Devil abilities with a cheerful expression.

chainsaw-man-000009.title: Reze among Flowers

chainsaw-man-000011.title: Reze — Bomb Devil
